description: String cleanup with a length cap. Nothing is missing from the purpose.

input.name: slugifyTitle
input.purpose: Turn a title into a URL slug and return it as a string. Lowercase it, replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen, and strip hyphens from both ends. Then, when the slug is longer than maxLength, cut it to maxLength characters and strip any hyphen left at the end.
